title: tasks: --accept is split as a shell splits it, quotes kept together
goal: A task's acceptance given to tasks start or tasks add as one line was split at every space, quotes and all, so a nextest filter such as -E 'package(x) | binary_id(y)' became a broken check (T-CLOUDCLAUDE-9, 11 to 14 had to be mended by hand). Split it as a shell would: single quotes literal, double quotes with backslash escapes, an unclosed quote refused.
